description: Reaction, comment and share counts for up to 10 public Facebook post URLs, from Facebook's public Embedded Post plugin: counts as shown (e.g. 1.2K) with a numeric estimate, page or author name, verified badge, publish time (UTC) and attached image. Totals only: who reacted is not available without login. Private, deleted or non-embeddable posts are listed under notFound. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_facebook_followers_following when you need Facebook Page follower counts from Facebook's public Page; social_facebook_comments when you need comments on a public Facebook post as a logged-out visitor. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
